items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Now, Weinfield was a good man.

ctx.x: Yeah, it wasn't just Weinfield. Now, Weinfield was a good man. He's a Jewish man that had charge of this circuit, but now he would sell the band to somebody in some certain areas, you know. And so it wasn't him. In fact, if he'd known it, he would have, you know, taken care of it.

But anyway, we got back to New York. Everybody was mad by that time. And they booked us on a tour that carried us all the way out to Texas. When we got to Kansas City, Buddy, Charlie Bird Freddy Culver, Orville Minor, several of them quit, you know. Gus and I -- and there was only a few of us that stuck with Max Hand. McShann
